name: Awakening of Od Laguna & The Wellspring of Mana
location: Core of the World / Od Laguna
description: Od Laguna serves as the fundamental core of mana and soul reincarnation, establishing the magical framework and elemental spirits of the flat world.

name: The Era of True Dragons & Primordial Spirits
description: Primordial Great Spirits and ancient dragons roamed the lands unbounded, shaping mountain ranges and natural flows of mana toward the Great Waterfall.

name: Dawn of Mortal Civilizations & Settlements
description: Humans, elves, dwarves, giants, and beastmen organized into the early regional principalities that eventually laid the borders for the Four Great Nations.

name: Reign of the Giant Kings
description: Powerful giant chieftains maintained territorial dominance over the southern wilderness before martial human warlords united to form early Imperial Vollachia.

name: The Dragon's First Blessing on Lugunica
description: Volcanica descends upon the high plateau, blessing the fertility of the soil and shielding early Lugunican tribes from cataclysmic elemental storms.

source.title: Royal Archives of the Dragon Kingdom

name: First Revelations of the Stargazers
description: The primitive Stargazers divine messages from the celestial canopy, inaugurating the divine mandate doctrine that would later shape the imperial succession of Vollachia.
